visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Kernighan's Trick
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The number is converted to a text of 0s and 1s and the 1s are counted one by one. Use n &= n - 1, which clears the lowest set bit each time. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Subtracting 1 flips the lowest set bit and the zeros below it, so n & (n - 1) removes exactly one 1 bit. The loop runs once per set bit and needs no string.
